findings.title: Releasing a captured text-selection drag over a link activates that link
findings.problem: The handler resolves and emits OpenLink for the runtime-generated trailingClick before recognizing that this click belongs to a completed drag. Users selecting text can trigger an application domain action unintentionally. The original non-captured pointer path suppressesClick afterdrag, so this is introduced by the new capture mechanism, not a pre-existing link behavior.
